budget.accounting: Completed r3 leases charged measured worker wall; incomplete claims charged full 285; require room for 285 before each lease.
budget.planning: 144 * first successful unit wall + 570; exceed => NON_FIT_BUDGET, stop pending lead. Also project remaining units after later actual costs.

evidence_class: reasoning: registration before CPU gates, no GPU execution
failure_policy: One RED receipt consumes unit and normal resume advances. Timeout => RED with NON_FIT; no forward chunking. Explicit retry-unit only for non-timeout RED once; second RED stops campaign. Incomplete claim stops pending lead, never auto-retry.
unit_scheme: One query per unit, original global query ordinal and cell query order. All registered arms and conditions share an in-unit capture; fresh model per lease. 12 per oracle cell, 24 per conditional natural cell; 144 total.
